t: Motion-activated, Focus outdoor wall light blends architectural lighting with discreet functionality. Dual up and down beam creates a defined lighting effect making it ideal for entrances, garden walls and patios. Crafted from high-quality aluminium and finished in dark grey, this outdoor wall light illuminates with dual-directional lighting that projects above and below to enhance outdoor spaces. Integrated PIR sensor offers a 10m detection range and 120° detection angle and has adjustable time and light sensitivity controls. Manual override provides the option to keep the light on constantly when needed, with auto shut-off for added safety. Compatible with 2 x GU10 bulbs (maximum 2 x 7W required). Supplied with fast-fit connector.
